summary: One real typo. Rave Master (Groove Adventure Rave) aired weekly Saturdays from 2001-10-13; ja-WP's 各話リスト carries a 初回放送日 column that gives ep 9 as 12月8日, matching en-WP's 2001-12-08. Stored dates carry no day shift for this series.

repairs.why: Ep 9 'A Bite to Eat' (プルーのひみつ) aired 2001-12-08; ja-WP 各話リスト 初回放送日 = 12月8日 and en-WP = December 8, 2001. Stored 2001-11-08 is a month-digit slip; it is what produced the flagged regression against ep 8 (2001-12-01, correct). Eps 10 and 11 (12-15, 12-22) are correct.

structure.notes: 51 rows, weekly Saturdays 2001-10-13 to 2002-09-28; numbering matches ja-WP and en-WP one-to-one.
